# Portrait photo credits

- `lina-original.jpg`: original fictional 28-year-old adult companion generated locally with ComfyUI and `juggernautXL.safetensors`; seed `2742819`.
- `moon-original.jpg`: original fictional 29-year-old adult companion generated locally with ComfyUI and `juggernautXL.safetensors`; seed `8274103`.
- `lina-photo.jpg`: Jake Nackos, [Unsplash photo IF9TK5Uy-KI](https://unsplash.com/photos/IF9TK5Uy-KI).
- `moon-photo.jpg`: Ivana Cajina (`@von_co`), [Unsplash profile](https://unsplash.com/@von_co).

The two generated portraits are the active built-in companions and do not depict a named real person. The legacy source images were published for free use under the Unsplash License. All assets are stored locally so the application does not depend on third-party image delivery at runtime.
